plan: A lamppost-wielding fighter who leaps onto his target and dodges every attack with his counter strike.
aSurveiller: His E (Counter Strike). He dodges all attacks for a moment then stuns around him: don't attack during it, back off.
contrer: Don't attack during his E: he dodges all your basic attacks, then stuns you.
Spells still hit him during his E: use them instead of your basic attacks.
Try to end the game quickly: he becomes very strong in the late game.
forces: Dodges all attacks with his E.
Very strong in duels and in the late game.
Leaps onto a target or an ally with his Q.
faiblesses: Relies on his E to win trades.
Weak at the very start of the game.

sorts.P: His consecutive attacks get faster and faster.
sorts.Q: Leaps to a unit and strikes it if it's an enemy.
sorts.E: Dodges attacks, then stuns around him.
sorts.R: Bonus damage every 3 attacks; resistances on activation.

momentFort.voie: Solid early, stronger and stronger in the mid and late game.
momentFort.jungle: Ganks easily from level 3 and wins most skirmishes. He gets even stronger with his items.
